# datasintef_edgegateway (Resource)

Manages an Edge Gateway (Firezone-backed) service instance in a datahub. Network resources reachable through the gateway go through a review workflow in dsn-api: requests must be approved by a service curator and then deployed. Terraform only submits `initial_resources` when creating the gateway; manage resources afterwards in the DataSintef portal. The current state is exposed in `resources` and `requested_resources`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "datasintef_edgegateway" "example" {
  datahub                     = "my-hub"
  service_alias               = "my-edgegateway"
  display_name                = "Lab network access"
  description                 = "Access to the lab network from the datahub"
  research_project_id         = "123456789-0"
  service_data_classification = "SINTEF Business Confidential"

  # Requested on creation and reviewed by a service curator. Manage resources
  # in the DataSintef portal afterwards; changes here are not sent.
  initial_resources = [
    {
      type                = "cidr"
      name                = "lab"
      address             = "10.0.0.0/24"
      comments            = "Instruments in the lab"
      network_owner_email = "network.owner@example.com"
      traffic_restrictions = [
        { protocol = "tcp", port_ranges = ["22", "8000-8100"] },
        { protocol = "icmp" },
      ]
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `datahub` (String) Alias of the datahub (e.g. 'my-hub'). Also accepts the datahub UUID.
- `description` (String) Description of the Edge Gateway service instance.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the Edge Gateway service instance.
- `initial_resources` (Attributes List) Network resources to request when the Edge Gateway is created (dsn-api requires at least one). They are filed for review unless the creator is a service curator or admin. Only used on creation: later changes are kept in state but not sent to dsn-api. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--initial_resources))
- `research_project_id` (String) Research project ID.
- `service_alias` (String) Alias of the Edge Gateway service instance.
- `service_data_classification` (String) Classification of the data/information the service instance holds. Valid values: Open, SINTEF Business Confidential, SINTEF Confidential. dsn-api only allows sharing a service with the public when it is classified as `Open`.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `addresses` (Attributes List) Service endpoint addresses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--addresses))
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the service was created.
- `group_id` (String) ID of the Firezone group granting access to the Edge Gateway.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the Edge Gateway service instance (datahub:service_alias).
- `last_modified` (String) Timestamp when the service was last modified.
- `requested_resources` (Attributes List) Network resources awaiting review or deployment, as reported by dsn-api. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--requested_resources))
- `resources` (Attributes List) Deployed network resources, as reported by dsn-api. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))
- `service_account_id` (String) ID of the Firezone service account of the Edge Gateway.

<a id="nestedatt--initial_resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `initial_resources`

Required:

- `address` (String) DNS name (Firezone glob syntax allowed), IP address or CIDR range, matching `type`.
- `name` (String) Name of the resource.
- `network_owner_email` (String) Email of the owner of the network the address belongs to.
- `type` (String) Type of the address: `dns`, `ip` or `cidr`.

Optional:

- `address_description` (String) Description of the address.
- `comments` (String) Comments for the reviewer.
- `traffic_restrictions` (Attributes List) Restricts traffic to the listed protocols. If unset, all traffic is allowed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--initial_resources--traffic_restrictions))

<a id="nestedatt--initial_resources--traffic_restrictions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `initial_resources.traffic_restrictions`

Required:

- `protocol` (String) Protocol: `tcp`, `udp` or `icmp`.

Optional:

- `port_ranges` (List of String) Ports or port ranges for `tcp`/`udp`, e.g. `443` or `8000-8100`. If unset, all ports are allowed.



<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) Time to wait for the service to become Ready (condition `Ready=True, reason=Available`) after a Create. Defaults to 20m. Must be less than the dsn-api 30 minute creation ceiling.
- `update` (String) Time to wait for the service to become Ready after an Update. Defaults to 15m.


<a id="nestedatt--addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `addresses`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) The endpoint URL.
- `description` (String) Description of the address.
- `type` (String) The address type (e.g. 'ui', 'api').

- `comments` (String) Comments for the reviewer.
- `id` (String) ID assigned by dsn-api.
- `name` (String) Name of the resource.
- `network_owner_email` (String) Email of the owner of the network the address belongs to.
- `revision` (String) Revision of the request; changes whenever the request is edited.
- `traffic_restrictions` (Attributes List) Allowed protocols and ports; null if all traffic is allowed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--requested_resources--traffic_restrictions))
- `type` (String) Type of the address: `dns`, `ip` or `cidr`.
